description.blurb: This moon of Jupiter, like many others, was discovered in 2003 at the Mauna Kea Observatory in Hawaii.
description.more: S/2003 J 4 is a member of the Pasiphae group, and has a mean radius of less than a mile (about 1 kilometer), assuming an albedo of 0.04. At a mean distance of about 15 million miles (23.9 million kilometers) from Jupiter, the satellite takes about 755 Earth days to complete one orbit.
